definitions: To become hostile or opposed to someone or something that one previously supported or was friendly with.
To betray or abandon someone or something.
examples: After the scandal, many fans turned against the politician.
The dog, once loyal, seemed to turn against its owner.
His own party members began to turn against him.
She felt her friends were starting to turn against her.
pastTenses: turned against (simple past), turned against (present perfect), turned against (past perfect)
